code:
name: Integration
on: [push]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: test
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-retries 10
        ports: ['5432:5432']
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '20' }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run migrate
      - run: npm test
summary_zh: GHA 加 postgres service 跑整合測試
